Summarise travel miles for each team

Source: R/travel.R
summarize_travel_miles.Rd

Aggregates the per-trip frame produced by calculate_travel_miles() into season totals, mean road-trip length, the longest single trip, and the furthest opponent visited. With the default itinerary travel model, totals include the return leg charged to the final game of each road trip.

Usage

summarize_travel_miles(travel, by = NULL)

Arguments

travel

A per-team-game travel frame from calculate_travel_miles(), or any data frame with team and trip_miles. is_home, round_trip, and opponent are used when present.

by

Character vector of grouping columns. Defaults to team plus season when season is available.

Value

A tibble with one row per group: the grouping columns, games, travel_games (games played away from home, including neutral-site "home" games), total_miles, mean_trip_miles, longest_trip_miles, furthest_opponent, and missing_trips (games with unknown mileage).

Examples

travel <- calculate_travel_miles(nfl_schedules_sample)
summarize_travel_miles(travel)[1:5, ]
#> # A tibble: 5 x 9
#>   team  season games travel_games total_miles mean_trip_miles longest_trip_miles
#>   <chr>  <int> <int>        <int>       <dbl>           <dbl>              <dbl>
#> 1 ARI     2024    17            8      19721.           2465.              3934.
#> 2 ARI     2025    17            9      19933.           2215.              3573.
#> 3 ATL     2024    17            8      10400.           1300.              3043.
#> 4 ATL     2025    17            9      21883.           2431.              8502.
#> 5 BAL     2024    19           10      15337.           1534.              4459.
#> # i 2 more variables: furthest_opponent <chr>, missing_trips <int>
